pairs.subject: watch-cache-and-resync
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useOpenAlertCount.ts:37 The context's data hooks do one request-driven read when the component mounts (re-run only when useMock, reloadKey or the locale changes), so no complete replica fed by a change stream or poll cycle exists here; searching src/components/dashboard for resync, desync, resourceVersion, lastOk and initialSync found 0 hits, and the only setInterval timers in the context drive UI ticks (relative time, ticker rotation), not data reads.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useOpenAlertCount.ts:48 One read per mount with no cursor or resumable stream, so there is no position that can expire and no desync state to model.

src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useExecutionHeatmap.ts:112 The grid is derived from one completed Promise.all and set in a single call, so nothing assembles a live replica incrementally. No re-read protocol exists for a swap to guard.

src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useExecutionHeatmap.ts:102 This is a plain bounded list read. The source offers no alternative initial-read protocol to choose between behind a capability gate.

src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useExecutionHeatmap.ts:119 No poll cycle writes rows. A failed read sets an error and keeps the previous rows instead of writing an empty result, which matches the technique's spirit, but its polled-replica precondition is absent.
src/components/dashboard/views/home/home-page/useExecutionHeatmap.ts:127 Each hook fetches for itself. No shared replica or stream is fanned out to consumers inside this context.
